description: This file contains Sass mixins for generating gradient backgrounds, including linear and radial gradients, with various directions and color options.

methods.name: gradient-bg
methods.description: A mixin to set a background color or gradient based on the '$enable-gradients' flag.

methods.name: gradient-x
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient with specified start and end colors and positions.

methods.name: gradient-y
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient with specified start and end colors and optional positions.

methods.name: gradient-directional
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient in a specified direction (angle) with start and end colors.

methods.name: gradient-x-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a three-color horizontal gradient with a midpoint color stop.

methods.name: gradient-y-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a three-color vertical gradient with a midpoint color stop.

methods.name: gradient-radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient with specified inner and outer colors.

methods.name: gradient-striped
methods.description: Creates a striped pattern gradient at a given angle with semi-transparent white stripes.
